_source: https://openmined.org/style-guide/#icons, fetched 2026-10-09: the live site's hosted icon set (61), as inline SVG, and the Ionicons it loads from a CDN on opt-in pages. Mapping to Iconoir: match = exact (same idea), close (nearest Iconoir icon, look differs), none (no Iconoir icon: draw our own or keep), status (a colored status icon), partner (a brand logo: use the partner mark), gap (a brand with no partner mark yet).
